_comment: Shipped preset for MiniMax Music 3 text-to-song, adapted from ComfyUI's official audio_minimax_music_3 template (flattened: SeedNode replaced by direct seed bindings on TextEncode #4 and KSampler #7, tiled-decode switch branch dropped in favor of plain VAEDecodeAudio — fine on high-VRAM GPUs). Chain: UNETLoader #1 + CLIPLoader #2 (type minimax) + VAELoader #3 -> MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode #4 (caption+lyrics+max_duration; its `seconds` output sizes EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio #6, so the latent always matches the AR token length) -> KSampler #7 (30 steps / cfg 1.7 / euler-simple, official defaults) -> VAEDecodeAudio #9 -> SaveAudioAdvanced #8 (mp3 V0). The two seeds (AR token generation on #4, diffusion on #7) both bind option:seed — identical when the user pins a seed, independently random otherwise.
label: MiniMax Music 3
description: Text-to-song via MiniMax Music 3 — full songs up to ~5 minutes with stable structure. main_prompt → caption (write style / mood / vocals / arrangement; the official guide suggests Global Metadata → Vocal Details → Arrangement), stage lyrics → lyrics with [intro]/[verse]/[chorus]/[bridge]/[outro] tags driving song structure, stage duration → max_duration (the model may end the song earlier). Requires minimax_music3_dit_fp16 + text encoder + dav VAE — see workflows/audio/README.md.

caption.default: Lo-fi hip-hop, chillhop, 78 BPM, laid-back and dreamy, soft vocals, dusty boom-bap drums, warm Rhodes piano, vinyl crackle.
